description: AdventureLive's 53 known routes (treks and high mountains such as Machame on Kilimanjaro, Everest Base Camp, the Tour du Mont Blanc, the Inca-country treks, and overland roads), each mapped from a named OpenStreetMap route. Use it when someone asks about a trek, a mountain route or an overland road: how long, how high, how many days, what the weather is like by month, and whether it needs a permit or a guide. Returns the distance and climb, the day-split variants (AdventureLive's own splits, never an operator's itinerary), weather by month from 10 years of ERA5 records where AdventureLive has them, the permit and guide rules only where an authority publishes them (with that source), and the route's page to plan it and let home follow live. Always pass on the weather first, say the splits are AdventureLive's own, give the rules' source, and pass on the liability lines: it is not a navigation aid and no substitute for a guide, a permit or local knowledge. Never add camps, huts, water or altitudes the answer doesn't give.

activity.description: Only one kind: trek, mountain (high mountain) or overland.

days.description: How many days they plan, to show that split when there is one.

month.description: The month they are going, for the weather that month.

route.description: The route, place or country as the user said it: "Machame", "Kilimanjaro", "Everest Base Camp", "Peru", "Tour du Mont Blanc". Leave it out to list them.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: find_adventure_routes

outputSchema.description: AdventureLive's known routes: the line's numbers, the day splits (ours), the weather by month, the sourced rules and the liability lines.

altitude_note.description: Above 3,000 m: the splits ignore acclimatising.

basis.description: historic: the weather is 10 years of ERA5 records by month, never a forecast; null when there are none.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong.

liability.description: AdventureLive's liability lines (wording.json), word for word. Always pass them on.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user.

route.description: One route (view "route"): slug, name, country, region, activity, km, climb_m, low_m, high_m, start, end, url (its AdventureLive page), published, variants ({ label, days, ours, legs: [{ day, km, climb_m }] }), rules ({ sourced, guide, permit, season, closure, notes, source: { name, url } }), weather ({ place, title, source, credit, method, columns, months } or null).

routes.description: Several routes (view "routes"): slug, name, country, activity, km, climb_m, high_m, variants (labels), weather_by_month, rules_sourced, url.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: a free account link, when the server adds one.

splits_note.description: The day splits are AdventureLive's own, not an operator's.

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Find a known adventure route
